classification: Synthetic constructed Bernoulli workload; not a PIMC result; not successful forecasting.

target.application_observable: Mean of next disjoint 64 Bernoulli samples
target.failure_rule: First post-alarm 64-sample block with absolute mean error >= .25
target.failure_time: T = t_a + 64 K, K first failing block
target.remaining_useful_samples: R = max(0,T-t_a) in additional sampling steps; not ESS
target.forecast_issuance: Once, at first alarm, using the complete identical observed prefix
target.abstention: Required if a single informative forecast is requested without a post-alarm law or identified mixture probability

experimental_units: 1024 independently seeded future continuations conditional on one fixed observed prefix; two scenarios paired by uniforms; not 2048 independent prefixes
identifiability: Both worlds assign identical laws to all observations through the alarm, but different conditional laws to R. Prefix-only observations do not identify which future law applies or a mixing weight between them.
